title: Urban Middle School Math Acceleration
focus_area: Personalized Math Instruction & Middle School Growth
diagnostic_used: Holistic Diagnostic (Student Empathy Interviews & Leadership Lens)
action_taken: Co-designed adaptive math learning pathways, trained peer coaches, and shifted 12 urban middle schools from isolated pilot classrooms to district-wide mastery pacing.
impact_metric: 28% increase in middle school math proficiency and a 40% reduction in algebra retake rates over 18 months.
